snippet: The Open Challenge Program 8.0 by Electropreneur Park Bhubaneswar, established by STPI with MeitY and Government of Odisha support, accelerates startups in ESDM sectors: Semiconductor Design, AI, IoT, Robotics, Embedded Systems, Smart Cities, AgriTech, DisasterTech, PCB Design, and Computer Vision.
